messagepanel.consequence: The spray can cut skin and inject water and chemicals into the body. An injection can look like a small cut but can cause serious injury or loss of a limb.
messagepanel.howtoavoid: Never point the spray gun at yourself, other people or animals.
Never put your hand or fingers in front of the nozzle.
Engage the trigger lock whenever you are not spraying.
If spray pierces the skin, get emergency medical care right away. Tell the doctor it is an injection injury.

messagepanel.consequence: The hose and spray gun stay pressurized after you stop the machine. Disconnecting a pressurized part can release a burst of water and cause injury.
messagepanel.howtoavoid: Relieve pressure before you disconnect the hose, change a nozzle, or service the machine.

messagepanel.consequence: Water and electricity together can cause death or serious injury.
messagepanel.howtoavoid: Plug the power cord only into a grounded outlet.
Keep the plug and the GFCI device on the cord out of water.
Test the GFCI device before each use. Do not use the machine if the test fails.
Do not use an extension cord.

messagepanel.consequence: Engine exhaust contains carbon monoxide, a poisonous gas you cannot see or smell. Breathing it can kill you in minutes.
messagepanel.howtoavoid: Run the engine outdoors only, at least 15 ft (4.6 m) from windows, doors and vents.
Never run the engine in a garage, basement, shed or other enclosed space, even with the door open.

messagepanel.consequence: Gasoline and its vapors are highly flammable. A spark or hot surface can ignite spilled fuel.
messagepanel.howtoavoid: Stop the engine and let it cool for at least 2 minutes before you add fuel.
Fill the tank outdoors, away from flames and sparks.
Wipe up spilled fuel before you start the engine.

messagepanel.consequence: Water left in the pump can freeze, crack the pump and void the warranty.
messagepanel.howtoavoid: Drain all water and add pump protector before you store the machine where temperatures can fall below 32 °F (0 °C).

messagepanel.consequence: Running the pump without water overheats the seals in seconds.
messagepanel.howtoavoid: Turn on the water supply and purge air from the system before you start the machine.
